notes: A genuinely SCANNED page: the whole of page 0 is one CCITTFaxDecode Group 4 image XObject (2925x4105, 1 bit, DeviceGray). There is no text layer - pdf.js returns zero text items - and no AcroForm, so nothing on this page is self-describing. Every bound below was annotated by eye from the 1241x1740 render named in `render`, helped by a ruled-line scan of that image, and is therefore approximate: the scan is faintly skewed and the rules are broken in places, so treat the bounds as good to a few render pixels rather than exact. Captions printed inside a box (the name/address and SSN cells) are excluded from the target, which covers only the writing strip beneath them; an amount cell carries no caption, so its target is the whole ruled cell. The printed cents divider inside each amount cell is folded into that cell rather than split out, because one amount is one answer. Pre-printed captions, the line-number stubs, the decorative rules and the hatched "Make check or money order payable to Internal Revenue Service" notice are not targets.
